invariant: Identity, placement, structural/subordinate, and transmission/kinematic relations are separate claim layers.
A broad relationship-verified label requires resolved references and negative controls for every claimed layer.
UNKNOWN physical attachment remains UNKNOWN and is not silently promoted or used to invalidate a bounded logical-graph candidate.

decisionTable.case: all required logical edges resolve and match scope
placement parent exists but belongs to wrong assembly

scopeBoundary: Does not reject the package, alter the train asset, certify engineering or physical attachment, or require a global OS change. It only prevents broad relationship claims from inheriting geometry/time evidence.
